data.title: 椎名真昼 · 阳台晚风与发绳整理·「隔壁的阳台……原来距离这么近呢」
data.description: 【相连的公寓阳台栏杆边·暮色】两户阳台只隔着短短的一道隔板。真昼手扶着栏杆，晚风将她耀眼的金发吹得微微凌乱。她抬起双手重新系紧发绳，侧头看向隔壁阳台端着热咖啡的周，唇角弯起罕见的、毫无伪装的天真笑容。
data.location: 高层公寓相通阳台栏杆旁
data.action: 双手抬起挽发整理发绳，微风拂动金发，侧颜回眸浅笑
data.lighting: 城市天际线暮色紫霞与阳台门廊暖光
data.camera: medium shot, balcony railing, fixing hair, hair up, evening breeze
data.promptProse: Mahiru Shiina stands at the railing of her apartment balcony in the purple twilight air, looking across the short divider toward the adjacent balcony. She raises both graceful arms to retie her golden hair as the evening breeze catches her flowing tresses and sweater. Her amber eyes sparkle with pure, unguarded delight, her profile painted by the radiant afterglow of the setting sun over the distant city skyline. Medium shot, cinematic twilight lighting, cityscape bokeh, detailed balcony background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
